notes.title: Version I.I.XXI
notes.notes:
Super tiny mini nano QOL update

- Adds language selection screen on first launch for all our amici, tomodachi and droogs. ^__^

notes.title: Version I.I.XX
notes.notes:
Minor update with big fixes!

- Fixed the annoying savegame bug where newer saves would be marked as OUTDATED
- MAJOR improvements to Japanese and Chinese locales, give it a go!!
- Some improvements to Korean, more to come.
- Some minor tweaks to English VO

Thanks for the patience and sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Version I.I.XV
notes.notes:
Minor update
- Partially improved Chinese, Korean and Japanese translations
- Enabled Help screen
- Added a small assistive feature for those hunting the elusive final achievement

notes.title: Version I.I.XII
notes.notes:
Yes, hello, is this thing working? 
Minor update:

- Fixes a couple dozen typos
- Fixed a bug where opening the [spoiler]TV Screen[/spoiler] cut off all the music and sound effects in the scene you called it from.
- Everything included in V I.I.IX (that broke^^')

notes.title: Please UPDATE THE GAME!
notes.notes:
The issue with game not running should be fixed now. 
Let us know if you face any troubles!

Again, thank you for your patience and support <3

notes.title: Version I.I.IX
notes.notes:
Small update
- Adds voice test on voice language choice
- Restores tooltip in main section of Preferences
- Quol auto-enabling DLC features on install

notes.title: Version I.I.VII
notes.notes:
Minor patch with a few fixes
- Fixed a bug where selecting a DLC English voice would cause an error if you switch to Japanese voice
- Re-enabled Japanese translation (still not final)

notes.title: Version I.I.VI
notes.notes: Minor patch re-enabling Polish translation and fixing a few missing lines in Italian translation.

notes.title: Version I.I.IV
notes.notes: Minor hotfix removing some orphaned variables in the script, fixing italic tags in a few scenes, and restoring broken text styles in non-Latin languages.
